records.location_name: Cornerstones Assistance Services and Pantry Program (ASAPP)
records.notes: Described as the largest food pantry in northwest Fairfax County open on weekdays and one Saturday morning a month. Get Help line (571) 323-9555 (Spanish line text also on page). Homebound food delivery available to seniors and residents of local low-income housing communities. SNAP at Market assistance at Reston Farmers Market (Saturday mornings in season). Eligibility documents not stated on the page.
records.raw_hours_text: 11484 Washington Plaza West, Suite 120 Mon-Thu: 8:30 am – 4:30 pm Fri: 8:30 am – 1:30 pm 1st Sat monthly: 9:00 am -1:00 pm

records.location_name: Grace to Go meal distribution - Leesburg Apartments
records.notes: Free prepared meals cooked by community volunteers and distributed weekly; start time only (no end time), so no structured schedule. Contacts: Grace To Go Co-Leads Jeff Jones (703-608-0017) or Charlie Greenhough (617-851-1306).
records.raw_hours_text: Meals are distributed every Sunday at 4 pm at the Leesburg Apartments at 75 Plaza Street.
records.raw_eligibility_text: The meals are available to anyone in the Leesburg community on a first-come, first served basis.

records.organization_name: Catholic Charities of the Diocese of Arlington
records.location_name: Loudoun Regional Food Pantry - Sterling
records.notes: By appointment only via online scheduling link on the page. USDA food distribution site; USDA eligibility determined at check-in. Loudoun Feeds describes it as serving all of Northern Virginia.
records.raw_hours_text: By appointment only: Daytime hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday: 10 a.m. – 2 p.m. Wednesday: 10 a.m. – 12 p.m. Evening hours: Tuesday and Wednesday, 5:15 – 7 p.m.
records.raw_eligibility_text: All Appointments have to be scheduled within 28 -30 days apart from each other. You will not be eligible to schedule an appointment if your last appointment was less than 28 days ago. ... Clients are eligible to receive food once every 30 days. Picture ID and Proof of current address required at every visit. Sterling Food Pantry is also a distribution site for USDA food.* Eligibility is determined at check-in with USDA food received at the time of your visit.

services.description: Perishable and non-perishable food including fresh produce, dairy, meat, and staples; USDA food for eligible clients

eligibility.details: By appointment only (online scheduling)
Once every 30 days; appointments at least 28 days apart
Picture ID at every visit
Proof of current address at every visit
